title: Despoina Self-Contained Accelerator Simulator
description: This public release is not intended to serve as a complete provenance archive of the paper’s experimental environment. Its purpose is to provide the core Despoina implementation as a self-contained, executable simulator. The included official profile builds and runs the Despoina simulator driver, PE-array runtime, dynamic row-mean path, DCIM path, and DRAMsim3 memory model on a generated synthetic t0+t1 workload. Its energy claim is limited to supported-component steady-state read/compute and native FIFO accesses, not full-chip or deployment energy. It contains no experiment results, reviewer data, checkpoints, or competitor baseline implementations. Licensing is file-scoped; see LICENSE.md and NOTICE. Version 1.1.0 aligns the simulator datapath with the paper's description: the PE accumulator streams only the row change dY to DCIM once per changed row, Z accumulates in place (whole layers in the 4 MB Post-Combination Buffer while they fit, the rest in HBM), no previous Y is stored, NPF H state is kept below tau and charged in HBM, and an NPF distance bound skips H_prev reads without changing any propagation decision. Version 1.0.0 (10.5281/zenodo.21510101) is the release cited in the MICRO 2026 artifact appendix; simulator outputs of 1.1.0 differ from it.
notes: Mixed file-scoped open licensing: Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0, MIT, BSD-2-Clause, and BSD-3-Clause apply to different files. See LICENSE.md, NOTICE, and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md; no single license applies to the whole archive.
